description: The chart illustrates the runtime comparison of various models in a streaming environment, displaying the runtime in seconds for different models. The horizontal axis lists the categories, labeled as "Our Joint Framework", "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude", while the vertical axis is labeled "Runtime (seconds)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, marked at intervals of 50. The chart features a single group of bars, with "Our Joint Framework" colored in dark green and the other four categories, referred to as "LLM Models" in the legend, colored in light blue. The dark green bar for "Our Joint Framework" has a value of 77 seconds, while the light blue bars have values of 190, 365, 172, and 243 seconds for "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude", respectively. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and none are visually emphasized. The chart effectively compares the runtime of the different models, with "Our Joint Framework" having the shortest runtime and "DeepSeek" having the longest among the LLM models.
